lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Tb8Ga2 (reduced formula LiTb4Ga) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 194), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Ga and Li center has 8 Tb neighbors, while each Tb center has 10 neighbors (2 Ga, 2 Li, and 6 Tb). The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner, edge, and face sharing among Tb-centered 10-vertex polyhedra, plus edge sharing between Ga- and Li-centered 8-vertex polyhedra.
